item.q: Put *never* in the right place: I drink coffee in the evening.
item.why: *never* (and other words for how often) goes before the main verb: *I never drink coffee in the evening.*
item.why_lv: *never* (un *citi* biežuma vārdi) stāv pirms darbības vārda: *I never drink coffee in the evening.*
